title: Time analysis of alveolar ridge preservation using a combination of mineralized bone-plug and dense-polytetrafluoroethylene membrane: A histomorphometric study
authors: Wen, S. C., Barootchi, S., Huang, W. X., & Wang, H. L. (2020). Journal of periodontology, 91(2), 215– 222.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss maxgraft granules (processed human allograft) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “This study provided the first histologic comparison of alveolar ridge preservation using a cancellous allograft and d-PTFE membrane at three different time points. Extraction sockets that healed for 6 months produced the highest amount of vital bone in combination with the leas t percentage of residual graft particles, while similar results were observed for the fraction of CT/other tissues between the three time points” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
